cases.description: Bound widgets (contract section 3), headless: FormatValue (one conversion / none / two -> literal / non-numeric -> literal / bool / string / missing -> Placeholder / stale text unchanged / non-finite -> Placeholder / Prefix+Suffix); GaugeFill clamp, reversed and degenerate ranges, non-finite -> 0; SliderValueAt H/V, Step snapping, out-of-rect clamps, degenerate rect. UiSystem::Update over a real Scene + DataBus: slider press-drag-release writes every frame and emits Signal on release only when the value changed (no double-emit on repeated edges, drag owns the pointer off-rect, off-window release ends the drag, Step through the production path, empty Signal, no bus => inert); toggle release-inside flips the bool and emits once (release-outside / press-outside do not, drag off-and-back fires, Interactable=false removes it, app writes respected); precedence (a UiImage over a slider does not block it, topmost of button/slider/toggle wins, Update returns true over any of them, the existing UiButton machine unchanged); CollectHostedPanels (V05 engine half) returns canvas-ordered rects/names/handles/scale and clears DrawnThisFrame; the seven reflected names under category UI with AssetPath/Color/Enum hints and no runtime members; a scene with all seven widgets round-trips through SceneSerializer field-exact with save->load->save byte-identical.
